Anna (Docs): Heads-up — migration guide PR #482 has been updated with the new v2 snippets. Need reviews + merge slot before cutover.
Sam (Eng): taking a look now. Is there a docs preview link?
Anna (Docs): https://docs-preview.redwood-internal/test/482 — note it's the v2 path: /docs/v2/migration. Also the feature flag notes live under /platform/flags.
Priya (Release): cutover date is Mar 19 2026 PDT. Docs cutoff for final merges is Mar 12 23:59 PT. Anything after that needs explicit approval.
Luis (SDK): FYI one SDK snippet uses the old `client.generate()` shape — pushed a small commit to switch to `client.text.generate()` in the PR. CI Bot: link-checker failed on 2 anchors in migration.md.
Anna (Docs): thanks @Luis (SDK). I'll re-run link-checker locally. Which anchors?
CI Bot: failures: #quickstart-v2 and #kv-cache-note — redirected but 302s causing the check to fail.
Sam (Eng): those anchors are new; probable mismatch in heading IDs. Quick fix: change `### Quickstart (v2)` to `### Quickstart v2` or add explicit anchor in markdown.
Anna (Docs): I'll add explicit anchor. Also need 2 approvers: @Sam (Eng) + @Priya (Release) per docs governance for migration guides.
Priya (Release): I can approve after the link errors are green and the PR has a changelog blurb. Add a short note about versioned docs and sys-admin steps.
Luis (SDK): added the changelog snippet and updated SDK snippet, pushed. CI Bot: tests passing except the link-checker; rerun is queued.
Anna (Docs): great — can we get a merge slot on Mar 10 (buffer before cutoff)? Prefer a weekday morning for fast rollback option.
Sam (Eng): Mar 10 morning works. I'll approve once link-checker passes and I sanity-check the example output.
Priya (Release): locking Mar 10 09:00 PT for merge window. If anything slips to Mar 13, it needs an explicit pager + rollback plan.
Anna (Docs): noted. I'll watch CI and ping here when the preview link updates.
CI Bot: link-checker passed — 0 failures. Preview updated: https://docs-preview.redwood-internal/test/482/preview
Anna (Docs): putting final checklist here: 1) link-check green (yes), 2) SDK snippet updated (yes), 3) changelog blurb (yes), 4) reviewer approvals (pending Sam+Priya).
Sam (Eng): approved. Verified code example output and headings.
Priya (Release): approved. Confirming merge on Mar 10 09:00 PT, I'll coordinate with infra for the small propagation TTL window.
Anna (Docs): thanks all :tada: I'll merge at the slot and watch the doc redirects. If anything weird happens we roll back and republish v1 landing page.
Luis (SDK): good plan. One follow-up: we should add a short SDK migration note in the README to reduce confusion. I'll open a tiny PR after this merges.
Anna (Docs): sounds good. Closing the thread once merged.
CI Bot: PR #482 merged by Anna (Docs) at 2198765500.
